scope: Four exact real companion matrices and eight scalar checks; no floating implementation or whole-codec certificate.

declined.why: Smith normal form is an integer-lattice invariant, while this matrix has non-integral rational entries
an index over ℤ requires an integral matrix; rational entries do not define an integer sublattice
the integer cokernel is undefined for a matrix with non-integral rational entries

findings.by: the dimension the rows span, from one exact elimination
a basis of the right kernel A·v = 0, from exact elimination; every null vector is a unique rational linear combination of these vectors
the dimension of the right kernel, equal to the number of columns minus the rank
the product of the pivots with the row swaps counted
the monic determinant of xI − A, computed by Berkowitz over the exact coefficient field; the structured factors, when available, are primitive integral representatives of distinct factors
the invariant factors of xI − A over ℚ[x], each dividing the next; two matrices are similar exactly when these monic lists agree, so this line is the whole similarity class
the largest invariant factor: the unique monic polynomial of least degree annihilating A
the minimal polynomial splits into distinct linear factors over ℚ, which is what diagonalisability is
the distinct real roots of the characteristic polynomial; decimal displays, when needed, are accompanied by exact defining polynomials and isolating intervals in real eigenvalue multiplicities
squarefree decomposition and Sturm isolation of the characteristic polynomial; the defining polynomials and rational isolating intervals are exact, including when a displayed name is decimal
